0022600169.text: The Trail Blazers come into this sixth game of the 2026-27 season at 4-1, with a 3-0 road record, a win in their most recent game, and a first-place spot in the Northwest. The Nuggets are 3-2 on a two-game winning streak, sitting third in the Northwest one game back and eighth in the West, and they will be without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). Portland will be missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and the teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season series, following a 2025-26 season series that Portland lost 1-3, including a 137-132 loss in Denver on April 6, 2026.
